review_scope: Exact Python distribution identities and declared licenses in both official ComfyUI v0.28.0 Windows NVIDIA portable assets.

asset_evidence.method: Immutable release metadata plus 7-Zip header indexes fetched with HTTP byte ranges; the multi-gigabyte payloads were not downloaded during this audit.

vulnerability_audit.requirements_source: Exact dist-info identities from both portable archive indexes; CUDA local version suffixes were normalized only for advisory lookup.

non_dist_info_components.name: CPython Windows embeddable security overlay
non_dist_info_components.license: Python-2.0; bundled third-party notices retained in LICENSE.txt

limitations: This is a point-in-time technical inventory and vulnerability review, not legal advice or final legal approval.

The pinned archives retain wheel-provided license and native-component notices. The index records their paths, but this metadata-only audit did not extract the multi-gigabyte payloads to hash each notice body.
A full archive SHA-256 check, exact overlay file hashes, an exact dist-info inventory check, and an isolated runtime version/import probe are required before a managed runtime can be activated.
